{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend trench coat in charcoal gray (#3a4548), knee-length, straight cut with a belted waist for wind protection, water-resistant fabric
Linen blend trousers in warm taupe (#c2b296), full-width leg, ankle length, relaxed fit for comfort in rain, breathable weave
Knit blouse in muted rust (#bc9b7e), classic collar, cropped hemline, soft drape, fine-gauge wool structure
Leather loafers in dark brown (#4a382c), square toe, low heel, smooth grain finish
Thin silk scarf in deep olive green (#4f5d36), rectangular shape, lightweight draping for subtle color accent
This ensemble honors her desire for a restrained and classic look while providing practical warmth and coverage against the persistent autumn rain. The structured silhouette of the trench coat and tailored trousers creates a professional yet approachable aesthetic suitable for a client meeting in a casual cafe setting. By prioritizing natural fabrics with water-resistant properties, the outfit ensures comfort and freedom of movement throughout the long day without sacrificing style."}
